title: anthropics/commerce-agents
why_read: An official reference architecture from Anthropic for building commerce-oriented LLM agents, useful for engineers building similar production agent systems.
analysis: This repo provides reference implementations and patterns for shopping/merchant agents built with Claude across retail, telecom, and entertainment verticals, likely covering tool use, state management, and safety considerations specific to commerce workflows. As an official vendor blueprint it offers practical, battle-tested patterns rather than novel research, valuable to engineers implementing agentic commerce systems. Its value is mostly as a well-documented starting template rather than a technical breakthrough.
